Private Function Safe(ByVal target As Object, ByVal name As String) As String
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Safe = CallByName(target, name, VbGet)
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Safe = "E" & Err.Number
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal dated As Boolean, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ch As Object, ax As Object, s As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ch = ws.ChartObjects.Add(100, 10, 300, 200).Chart
    ws.Range("A1").Value = "k"
    If dated Then
        ws.Range("A2").Value = DateSerial(2026, 1, 1): ws.Range("A3").Value = DateSerial(2026, 1, 15)
        ws.Range("A4").Value = DateSerial(2026, 3, 1)
    Else
        ws.Range("A2:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("a", "b", "c"))
    End If
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("C1:C4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("w", 4, 0.5, 6))
    ch.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:C4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
    Case 1
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = xlTimeScale
    Case 2
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = xlCategoryScale
    Case 3
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = xlCategoryScale: ax.CategoryType = xlAutomaticScale
    Case 4
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
    Case 5
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = xlCategoryScale
    Case 6
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = xlTimeScale
    Case 7
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.BaseUnit = xlMonths
    Case 8
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.BaseUnit = xlYears
    Case 9
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.BaseUnit = xlMonths: ax.BaseUnitIsAuto = True
    Case 10
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.BaseUnit = 5
    Case 11
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.MajorUnit = 2: ax.MajorUnitScale = xlMonths
    Case 12
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
    Case 13
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = xlCategoryScale
    Case 14
        ch.ChartType = xlLine
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.BaseUnit = xlDays
    Case 15
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ch.Axes(xlValue).CategoryType = xlTimeScale
    Case 16
        ch.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
        Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
        ax.CategoryType = 7
    End Select
    Set ax = ch.Axes(xlCategory)
    s = Safe(ax, "CategoryType") & "," & Safe(ax, "BaseUnit") & "," & Safe(ax, "BaseUnitIsAuto")
    Tried = "ok " & s
Saved:
    wb.SaveAs folder & "\c" & which & ".xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Saved
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(0, False, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(1, False, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(2, False, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(3, False, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(4, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(5, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(6, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(7, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(8, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(9, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(10, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(11, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(12, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(13, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(14, False, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(15, True, folder)
    s = s & "@@@" & Tried(16, True, folder)
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
